ana.bn.page.title: Bottlenecks
ana.bn.page.subtitle: What holds money and work up: the amount held, a standard cause, the age of the debt and who holds it; one amount that two sources describe is counted once.
ana.bn.cut: The source {sources} holds more rows than were read; the total is a lower bound.
ana.bn.skipped: {source}: {count} rows have no day, so their age cannot be told and they are not included.
ana.bn.tile.lowerBound: A lower bound: {count} items have no amount
ana.bn.tile.mergedNote: Described by two sources, counted once
ana.bn.cause.title: By cause
ana.bn.cause.caption: Each row is a standard cause with the module that answers for it, the action expected, the number of items and the amount
ana.bn.cause.PAYMENT_PENDING_TREASURY: Waiting for the Treasury to pay
ana.bn.cause.PAYMENT_PENDING_DOSSIER: Waiting for the payment dossier to be checked
ana.bn.action.LAND_CLEARANCE: Speed up the payment of compensation and the handover of the site
ana.bn.action.PAYMENT_PENDING_TREASURY: Follow up with the Treasury on the dossier sent
ana.bn.action.PAYMENT_PENDING_DOSSIER: Finish the check or send the dossier back for completion
ana.bn.action.ISSUE_UNRESOLVED: Solve the issue or escalate it by the SLA
ana.bn.action.DESIGN_APPROVAL: Push for the approval of the design
ana.bn.action.PROCUREMENT_DELAY: Review the schedule of the selection of the contractor
ana.bn.action.CONTRACTOR_CAPACITY: Talk to the contractor about staff and equipment
ana.bn.action.FORCE_MAJEURE: Monitor it and plan how to catch up
ana.bn.action.LEGAL_PROCEDURE: Finish the legal procedure that is missing
ana.bn.action.default: Name who is responsible and the day to deal with it
ana.bn.bucket.title: By age of the debt
ana.bn.holder.title: Who holds the most
ana.bn.items.title: The list by amount times days
ana.bn.items.caption: Each row is an item held with its project, source, cause, amount, age and holder
ana.bn.na.other: There is no amount because data is missing.
ana.halt.page.title: Halted projects
ana.halt.page.subtitle: Each halted project has a dossier: a standard cause, the reason in words, since when, and a restart plan with owners and days that somebody other than its author approves.
ana.halt.gap.title: Suspended projects with no dossier
ana.halt.gap.body: These projects are suspended but have no record of the reason and no restart plan.
ana.halt.record.title: Make the dossier of a halted project
ana.halt.record.done: The dossier of the halt was made.
ana.halt.list.title: Halt dossiers
ana.halt.list.caption: Each row is a dossier: project, cause, days halted, status and the state of the restart plan
ana.halt.plan.saved: The plan was saved as a new version; it waits for somebody else to approve it.
ana.halt.plan.maker: The author of a plan does not approve their own plan.
ana.halt.plan.edit: Make or change the restart plan (at least {min} steps)
ana.halt.plan.ownerNote: Each step is given to the unit that owns the project.
ana.halt.detail.title: Halt dossier
ana.halt.detail.error: The dossier could not be read.
ana.halt.steps.title: Steps of the plan (version {version})
ana.halt.steps.none: There is no restart plan yet.
ana.halt.problem.self: The author of a plan does not approve their own plan.
ana.halt.problem.denied: You have no right over this.
ana.halt.problem.stepsOpen: A step is neither done nor dropped, so the restart is not recorded yet.
ana.halt.problem.exists: The project already has an open halt dossier.
ana.halt.problem.state: The dossier has changed state, so it could not be done; reload.
ana.halt.problem.stage: A dossier is made only for a project that is suspended.
ana.halt.problem.invalid: The content is not valid: check the cause, the day and the words.
ana.halt.problem.gone: The dossier is no longer in your scope.
ana.halt.problem.failed: It could not be done; try again.
